title: Residence of judge.
bodyText: Every judge of a circuit court shall reside in the circuit for which the judge is appointed.
bodyHtml: §603-6  Residence of judge.  Every judge of a circuit court shall reside in the circuit for which the judge is appointed. [L 1892, c 57, pt of §30; RL 1925, §2242; RL 1935, §3638; RL 1945, §9636; RL 1955, §215-6; HRS §603-6; gen ch 1985]
